limitations: Bounded randomized agreement with a saved solver is not proof of semantic completeness.
rule: Group cells by colour; crop each colour to its tight bounding box keeping only that colour. Output the unique crop that equals its own left-right mirror.
scope: Supported: 3..6 distinct-coloured shapes (colours 1..9) on background 0, grids 12..30 per side, shape bounding boxes 3..9 wide and 3..8 tall, non-overlapping with a one-cell gap, possibly disconnected shapes, distractors that are random or near-symmetric with 1-2 cells broken. Not supported: non-zero backgrounds, overlapping bounding boxes, up-down or rotational symmetry as the criterion, zero or multiple symmetric shapes (the solver's largest fallback is never exercised).
constraints: Exactly one colour's bounding-box crop is left-right symmetric; all others are asymmetric (checked explicitly).
Every pattern is tight (touches all four sides of its bounding box) so the crop equals the latent pattern.
All colours distinct and nonzero; background is 0.
Random bounding boxes never overlap and are separated by at least one background cell, so no incidental merging or occlusion.
Patterns have at least 4-5 cells and are never fully filled, avoiding trivial single-column or solid candidates.
Minimum width 3 so symmetry is never trivially satisfied by a 1-wide shape.
known_limitations: Background is fixed at 0, matching all fixtures; non-zero backgrounds are not sampled.
Fixture replay uses explicit latent shape patterns rather than parameter extraction, so validate() carries the fixture shapes verbatim as latent data.

Fixture bounding boxes may share a row range (e.g. pair 1 colours 3 and 4) while random generation enforces fully disjoint boxes with a gap, so the random distribution is slightly stricter than the originals.
Near-symmetric distractors differ from symmetric shapes by only 1-2 cells, which is intended as a hard distractor; patterns are random so some distractors may be sparse/visually noisy.
billing: Claude Max CLI; API credentials excluded; no API fallback

checks: Unique symmetric colour-group crop amid random and near-symmetric distractors
Disconnected same-colour pieces allowed; separated tight bounding boxes
Output derived from selected latent pattern
No archived solver import or file I/O
